title: Compression Effects on Low-Resource Multilingual Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a pilot study characterising the effect of post-training quantisation on multilingual machine translation quality and inference cost for three African languages - Hausa, Swahili, and Yoruba - across three model families: a small general-purpose LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B), a larger multilingual instruction-tuned LLM (Aya-23-8B), and a dedicated multilingual MT model (NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B). Evaluating on the FLORES-200 devtest set (1,012 sentences per direction) under FP16, bitsandbytes INT8, and NF4 INT4 precisions on consumer-grade NVIDIA T4 GPUs, we find: (i) the specialised MT model outperforms both LLMs by 32.7-43.3 chrF on the Hausa and Swahili directions, and by 12.9-24.7 chrF on Yoruba, despite being roughly a sixth the size of the 8B instruction-tuned LLM; (ii) post-training quantisation preserves aggregate translation quality within approximately 1 chrF across all model families and language directions, with a single worst

translated_title: 压缩对低资源多语言翻译的影响
translated_abstract: 我们呈现了一项初步研究，系统表征了训练后量化对多语言机器翻译质量与推理成本的影响，研究对象为三种非洲语言——豪萨语、斯瓦希里语和约鲁巴语，涵盖三个模型系列：一个小型通用大语言模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B）、一个更大的多语言指令微调大语言模型（Aya-23-8B），以及一个专门的多语言机器翻译模型（NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B）。我们在消费级 NVIDIA T4 GPU 上，以 FP16、bitsandbytes INT8 和 NF4 INT4 三种精度，在 FLORES-200 devtest 测试集（每个方向 1,012 个句子）上进行评估，研究发现：(i) 专门的机器翻译模型在豪萨语和斯瓦希里语方向上比两个大语言模型高出 32.7-43.3 chrF，在约鲁巴语方向上高出 12.9-24.7 chrF，尽管其规模仅为 8B 指令微调大语言模型的约六分之一；(ii) 训练后量化在所有模型系列和语言方向上都将整体翻译质量保持在约 1 chrF 的损失范围内，最差的单一情况……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了训练后量化（FP16/INT8/INT4）对三种低资源非洲语言机器翻译的影响，发现专用MT模型以约六分之一的参数量显著优于通用大语言模型，而量化带来的质量损失仅约1 chrF。
en_tdlr: This pilot study systematically characterizes how post-training quantisation (FP16/INT8/INT4) affects low-resource multilingual translation for Hausa, Swahili, and Yoruba, showing that a dedicated MT model outperforms much larger LLMs by wide margins while quantisation preserves translation quality within approximately 1 chrF.
